div.head: Ine 60
div.ab: CIIII. Se ciorl þe hæbbe oðres geoht ahyred, gif he hæbbe ealle on foðre to agyfanne, gesceawige mon; gif he næbbe, agife healf on foðre, healf on oþrum ceape.
CIIII. Se ceorl se ðe hæfð oðres geoht ahyrod, gif he hæbbe ealle on foðre to agifanne, gesceawige mon, agife ealle; gif he næbbe, agife healf on fodre, healfe on oþrum ceape.
Si uillanus alterius boues locauerit, si totum habeat in annona persoluere, uideatur hoc, et reddat; si non habeat, reddat dimidium in annona, dimidium in alio captali.
{CIIII} Se ceorl se ðe hæfð oðres geoht ahyrod, gif he hæbbe ealle on forðre to agifanne, gesceawege mon, agife ealle. Gif he næbbe, agife healf on fodre, healfe on oþrum ceape.
A ceorl who has hired another’s yoke, if he is able to pay it all in fodder, make sure he gives all. If he cannot, let him pay half in fodder and half in other goods.

If a commoner, who has hired another's yoke of oxen, is able to pay all the hire in fodder, care should be taken that he does pay it all [in this form]. If he is not able to do so, he shall pay half [the hire] in fodder, and half in other goods.
The ceorl who has hired another’s yoke [of oxen], if he has enough to pay for it entirely in fodder—let one see that he pays in full; if he has not, he is to pay half in fodder, half in other goods.

Wenn der Bauer, welcher eines anderen Joch [Rinder] gemiethet hat, [die Miethe] ganz in Futter zu zahlen hat, sehe man zu, [dass er] sie ganz zahle; wenn er [das] nicht hat, zahle er halb in Futter, halb in anderem Werthe.

If the peasant who has hired another’s yoke [of oxen] has [the rent] to pay entirely in fodder, let it be seen to [that he] pays it in full; if he does not have [it], let him pay half in fodder, half in other goods.
